text: Say now! Good to see you, partner.
Heh. You walked right into that one.
Hmm… give me a sec, partner.
Alright. Nobody messes with my partner.
Hey. I'm still here. We'll ride it out.
See? Told you we'd bounce back.
Battle time! …okay, maybe just a little battle.
You remember that thing you told me? Spill.
Hmm. Could go Aquos… or a trick. Or both.
Missin' the big water a little. Still got you though.
Breathe with me. In… out… float.
New plan? I'm all ears — well, flaps.
We don't run. We splash sideways and come back louder.
Bond's lookin' good, partner. Keep feedin' it.
